title: Fujino scores twice as Man City win 4-1 in Italy
lead: After three draws, Manchester City have finally won a match in the Women's Champions League, with a 4-1 victory against Inter Milan.
body: On Tuesday 10 November 2026, Manchester City Women played Inter Milan in the Women's Champions League. Before this game, City had drawn their first 3 matches in the competition, so they really needed a win.

It started badly for the English team. Elisa Bartoli scored for Inter after 24 minutes. But Aoba Fujino replied with a goal in the 33rd minute, and she scored again just before half-time. 2-1 to City!

In the second half, City kept attacking. Kerstin Casparij, the captain on the night, made it 3-1, and Grace Clinton scored a fourth goal after a cross from Lauren Hemp. City had 21 shots in the match.

Thanks to this first win, City have climbed to 7th place. On the same evening, another English team, Chelsea, were frustrated: they drew 0-0 in Sweden against BK Häcken, but they are still 3rd in the table.
